title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 37
description: Ten questions on Psalms 37: do not fret because of evildoers, delight in Yahweh, and the humble shall inherit the land.

questions.text: In verse 2, like what will evildoers soon be cut down?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says they shall soon be cut down like the grass and wither like the green herb.

questions.text: What will Yahweh give those who delight themselves in him?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says, "Delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart."

questions.text: In verse 6, Yahweh will make your justice shine out like what?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.

questions.text: According to verse 11, in what shall the humble delight themselves?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says the humble shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

questions.text: What does the Lord do at the wicked who plots against the just?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says the Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.

questions.text: Like what will the enemies of Yahweh vanish, according to verse 20?
questions.explanation: Verse 20 says they will vanish like smoke.

questions.text: What does verse 21 say the wicked do?
questions.explanation: Verse 21 says the wicked borrow and don't pay back, but the righteous give generously.

answers.text: They borrow and don't pay back

questions.text: What does the speaker say about himself in verse 25?
questions.explanation: Verse 25 says, "I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken."

answers.text: "I have been rich, and now am poor"
"I have been a king over many nations"
"I have been young, and now am old"
"I have been a stranger in a far land"

questions.text: In verse 35, how was the wicked in great power spreading himself?
questions.explanation: Verse 35 says he was spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.

answers.text: Like a green tree in its native soil
Like a lion in the forest
Like a cloud over the hills

questions.text: What does verse 39 call Yahweh for the righteous in the time of trouble?
questions.explanation: Verse 39 says Yahweh is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
